answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 924 Country: United Kingdom Title: Please could you answer my question straight forward. Is marriage Taqdeer Muallaq? Can this destiny be changed? Question: Please could you answer my question straight forward. Is marriage Taqdeer Muallaq? Can this destiny be changed? Answer ID: 924 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1023=756/H) The straightforward reply is not to indulge in discussion about destiny, but only believe in destiny good or bad is from Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
